correctness.rationale: The Kneser graph on n-subsets of [2n] is exactly a complement matching, giving the join of N=binom(2n,n)/2 two-point complexes. Its label action is an orthogonal signed permutation on pair coordinates; fixed coordinates are one per orbit precisely when its pair stabilizer does not exchange the halves, proving the PL fixed-sphere statement including d=0. For a transposition, all fixed pairs have positive sign (n>=2), and the b/2 remaining swapped-pair blocks have determinant -1, b=binom(2n-2,n-1). Legendre gives v2(b)=number of ones in n-1, hence b/2 odd iff n-1 is a binary power. Degree gives integral top character; rational transfer plus Armstrong using fixed-point transpositions proves the quotient statements. Independently reconstructed signed permutation matrices and verified all 41064 elements of S4,S6,S8 and fixed transposition dimensions for n=2,3,4; finite checks corroborate but are not the universal proof.
residual_risks: The quotient statement is rational; integral quotient torsion/homotopy are not determined.
